description: ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 23 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Linéaire du cable sous-marin de télécommunication de traverser de la M; Carte de couverture 2G (voix) à partir de données ARCEP 2025 T3; Zones d'exploitation liées aux servitudes PT3 (Réseaux de télécommunic; Assiette de servitude PT3 liée aux passage de cable de télécommunicati. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
